newsitem.title: MEXICO: Cemex not pursuing two Brazil cos - Salomon.
newsitem.headline: Cemex not pursuing two Brazil cos - Salomon.

text.p: Mexican cement company, Cemex, is not pursuing bidding for two Brazilian cement companies, Cimento Caue and Serrana de Mineracao, Salomon Brothers analyst Carmen B.T. Slade said in a report on Tuesday.

"In conversations with Cemex late yesterday, we confirmed that the company will not be pursuing bidding for either Cimento Caue or Serrana de Mineracao, two cement companies in Brazil," said Slade. She said speculation this bidding might go forward has contributed to Cemex underperforming the Mexican bolsa in recent weeks.
"Therefore we expect the stock to react positively to this news and we reiterate our Buy recommendation," she said.
Salomon Brothers said that, based on its target price of $10 per ADR, it believes Cemex has a potential upside of 38 percent from current levels.
